column1: # PROVENANCE for everything in theme/canonical/. Data, not prose, because
# docrender/theme.py READS this file on every build and compares blob_sha
# against the bytes actually on disk.
# WHY THE VENDORED TABLE HAS NO HEADER COMMENT
# Every other TSV in this engine opens with a comment block. canonical/colors.tsv
# does not, and that is deliberate: a comment would change its bytes and destroy
# the one thing that proves it IS the canonical table. Its identity is its hash.
# So the commentary lives here instead. Do not "tidy" a header into it.
# WHAT THE CHECK PROVES, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT
# PROVES: the file on disk is byte-for-byte what we vendored. Catches a hand
# edit, a partial write, an editor that stripped a trailing newline or converted
# tabs -- the failure modes that turn a design system into a lookalike.
# DOES NOT PROVE: that what we vendored is still current upstream. That needs a
# scheduled job with network access, and it does not exist yet. WARNING: stated
# rather than implied, because a green check that answers a narrower question
# than the reader assumes is worse than no check.
# HOW TO REFRESH: replace the file wholesale from the source repo, put the new
# blob SHA here, and re-run the build. Never edit a vendored file in place --
# it is not ours, and an in-place edit is a fork nobody declared.
# REFRESH LOG. Newest first. A stamp with no history cannot answer "when did
# this last move, and why" -- which is the first question anybody asks when a
# colour changes and nobody remembers approving it.
# 2026-08-05  e14e3a6 -> 667e4a9  THE SPLIT. maw-themes c7c7e86. 37 -> 38 cols,
#             19 -> 23 rows. J10/S1 implemented for THREE identities: eos,
#             mclaren and default each now have a COMPLETE dark row and a
#             COMPLETE light row, alt- band empty on all six. New `identity`
#             column groups a pair (Cleo's answer from W2 -- grouping is
#             symmetric, a pair pointer can dangle). 37 values authored, each
#             measured against BOTH its canvas and its card.
#             RED THIS BROKE `light: eos` IN site.yml AND THE BREAK WAS SILENT:
#             a complete dark row asked for the light scheme paints its dark
#             ramp there. Fixed to `light: eos-light`; theme.py now reports the
#             mistake by name and points at the sibling.
#             13 rows still carry the alt band. Both shapes resolve through the
#             same function, so the rest migrate per-row with no flag day.
# 2026-08-05  eade05c -> e14e3a6  TWO CELLS, eos alt- band. maw-themes b59f82f.
#             alt-text #39ff14 -> #241f2b (the placeholder green retired;
#             1.23:1 -> 14.55:1) and alt-accent #e0459b -> #bd2a75 (still
#             magenta, but the shared value measured 3.46:1 on the light ground
#             and now measures 5.06:1). First use of the alt- band for a reason
#             other than ground and text.
# 2026-08-05  27b5327 -> eade05c  eos dark ramp RE-AUTHORED (7 cells) + ONE NEW
#             COLUMN, alt-accent. 36 -> 37 columns. maw-themes commit 9efb6a2.
#             text -> #ecedf2 near-white; the amber #ecbd5b moves to `accent`;
#             on-accent -> #1a1508 (white on amber would be 1.75:1 -- this also
#             clears eos from maw-themes D7, which measured 3.82:1); magenta
#             demoted to accent-2; deep and soft stops follow the new hue.
#             WHY THE COLUMN: `accent` is shared across modes, and amber on the
#             light ground measures 1.58:1. alt-accent keeps LIGHT on magenta,
#             which is what "leave the light theme alone" requires. It is D5
#             (brand colours authored per mode) implemented for the first row
#             that needs it. NO CODE CHANGED -- _canonical_decls() looks for
#             alt-<token> for every token, not from a hardcoded list.
#             maw-themes commit 8db6302. A deliberate PROOF VALUE, not a design
#             decision: Michael asked for a wild colour in the eos LIGHT ramp to
#             confirm a published page really is painted from the canonical
#             table. STILL 5,710 BYTES. A size check would have passed this
#             unchanged, which is the whole argument for hashing over measuring.
# 2026-08-04  --      -> 4f391aa  Initial vendor. 19 themes x 36 columns.

column7: 23 rows x 38 columns. 6 rows are COMPLETE palettes (empty alt band, paired by identity); 13 still carry the legacy alt band; default-theme is mid and has neither. SHA computed locally and matched against the SHA GitHub returned for the upstream write, before this file was committed.
